description: This file is a shell script used for testing git checkout operations, including various scenarios of branch switching, ref handling, and state management.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: A function that runs 'git checkout' with various options, expecting success or failure, and verifies the resulting state.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Tests that diff --exit-code returns a specific failure code when unmergeable changes are present.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Tests that diff --exit-code succeeds after discarding unmergeable changes.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up the repository with unmergeable changes for testing.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Tests that diff --cached --exit-code fails when mergeable changes are staged.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Tests that diff --cached --exit-code succeeds after discarding mergeable staged changes.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Sets up the repository with mergeable changes staged for testing.
